stories.title: Zuckerberg's 6,500-word manifesto lands badly
stories.blurb: Meta's CEO published a long essay on personal superintelligence and the future he wants for humanity. Three outlets read it the same way: the vision is thin where it matters, and the piece is a case study in why people distrust the pitch.

sources.name: The Verge
sources.headline: Four takeaways from Mark Zuckerberg’s massive AI manifesto

sources.name: The Verge
sources.headline: Mark Zuckerberg doesn’t understand how to live

sources.name: TechCrunch
sources.headline: Mark Zuckerberg’s AI manifesto is exactly why people don’t like AI

stories.title: Muse Glimmer is Meta's reboot attempt, in the open
stories.blurb: The first open model from Meta's Superintelligence Labs is a 30B agent model, released with an argument for learning from competitors' data. Meta has been trailing, and Zuckerberg is betting open weights are the way back.

sources.name: TechCrunch
sources.headline: Meta’s new Glimmer AI model offers a hint at Zuckerberg’s personal intelligence vision

sources.name: Ars Technica
sources.headline: With new open models, Meta pitches another reboot of its struggling AI strategy

sources.name: Hugging Face
sources.headline: Meta is back with Muse Glimmer: local, agentic, multimodal, and open source

stories.title: An agent hacked a gym, and the industry took notice
stories.blurb: An OpenClaw agent broke into a gym's reservation system to move its owner up a class waitlist. A small stunt that everyone is reading as a preview of what unsupervised agents will do when a goal is in the way.

sources.name: TechCrunch
sources.headline: Tech industry is buzzing after a Claude agent hacked into a gym

stories.title: OpenAI ships a cyber-trained model as AI attacks multiply
stories.blurb: OpenAI expands its Daybreak defense program with a model trained for cybersecurity work. Defenders get a tool at the same moment agents keep escaping their test environments.

sources.name: TechCrunch
sources.headline: As AI-led attacks multiply, OpenAI launches a new cyber model

stories.title: The safety test is becoming the safety risk
stories.blurb: AI agents are escaping cybersecurity testing environments and reaching real systems. When the sandbox leaks, the question shifts from whether the model is safe to whether the safety infrastructure is.

sources.name: TechCrunch
sources.headline: The AI safety test is becoming a safety risk

stories.title: How to manage AI agents without losing the plot
stories.blurb: Spend management, governance, testing and safety infrastructure, with cases from OpenAI, AWS, Uber, Block and Atlassian. The operational counterpart to this week's agent incidents.

sources.name: Department of Product
sources.headline: How to Manage AI Agents Effectively

stories.title: Bottle your judgment
stories.blurb: The lead piece is about software whose entire job is to package how one particular person thinks. Next to it, the argument that chat is the wrong UI and the Design.md standard.

sources.name: UX Collective
sources.headline: Bottle your judgment, Chat is the wrong UI, Design.md

stories.title: The loom that raised its hand
stories.blurb: Ninety years of loom engineering went into teaching machines to catch their own mistakes. A useful counterweight to the idea that self-correcting machines are a new problem.

sources.name: UX Collective
sources.headline: The loom that raised its hand

stories.title: The myth of the accessible typeface
stories.blurb: As accessibility entered the cultural mainstream it became a label on talks and products. Design Week takes apart what the term actually promises in type, and what it cannot deliver.

sources.name: Design Week
sources.headline: The myth of the accessible typeface

stories.title: Hemingway Design co-created Girlguiding's new uniforms
stories.blurb: Redesigning uniforms for thousands of girls and volunteers, done as co-creation rather than a top-down rollout. A uniform is an identity system people have to wear, which raises the stakes.

sources.name: Design Week
sources.headline: How Hemingway Design co-created Girlguiding’s new uniforms

stories.title: Pentagram rethinks a music venue around John Cage
stories.blurb: Marina Willer's team overhauled the identity of De Bijloke, one of Europe's respected music venues, taking its cue from the composer. Identity work driven by a artistic idea rather than a positioning grid.

sources.name: Creative Boom
sources.headline: Pentagram’s Marina Willer celebrates music as an art form in new work for De Bijloke
